items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

ctx.x: Give us an example of a couple that were close.

You know what you say is very true and I find myself having to watch that when you do Gospel, and especially the now generation Gospel. I have to really closely listen to what’s being said, you know, to kind of slow down and respect the fact that they’re singing Gospel. Unlike when I came along, my father was Baptist, was Methodist. My mother was Baptist. So I was christened as a Methodist as a baby, and I sang in that choir when I became of age. But each summer when I had to work in the fields in cotton and…
And just peak over the glasses.
